verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only SigNoz acting as an MCP server, which lets external agents like Claude and Cursor query SigNoz. That is the opposite direction from this story. Nothing shows SigNoz itself consuming or plugging in external MCP servers to use their tools. Because observability platforms could plausibly ship such a client capability, the axis applies, and the lack of evidence makes this 'none'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
